_comment: The regcf subject sidecar. Everything the pipeline needs to know about
THIS body of law lives here; everything about the pipeline itself lives in
etc/go/. Validated by etc/go/lib/subject.mjs, which refuses unknown keys
and missing files. Free-prose idiosyncrasies live in NOTES.md, which no
script reads. All paths are repo-root-relative.
'denovo' declares where this subject's G2 deposits live. Those paths'
EXISTENCE is optional: producing them is agent work (fetch, sweep, encode,
fork), and the stages report SKIPPED with a named reason until they appear.
As of 2026-08-09 all five declared deposits ARE on disk, committed by the
de novo runs of 2026-08-05..09. 'denovo.modules' may not name a corpus
module -- SPEC.md section 8's diff oracle compares the de novo encoding
AGAINST the committed one, so a de novo module that IS the corpus makes that
comparison an identity.
'denovo.checks' floors measure the DEPOSIT, never the corpus (per-origin
floors, 2026-08-09). min_assertions 39 = assertions_total from 'l4 run
--json' results[] over regcf-denovo.l4, the figure p6-tests compares against
(the source text carries 40 '#ASSERT' strings; the 40th is prose in a
comment at regcf-denovo.l4:3590). min_dated_arms 0 = the population under
p3-check's matcher: the module routes rule-date logic through a helper
abstraction over YMD constants, which that matcher cannot see -- NOTES.md
has the census. A 0 floor makes p3-check report the sub-check NOT CHECKED
rather than vacuously green.
